integrity: Proof and two independent finite checkers accompany the manuscript; finite checks confirm examples and the exceptional lemma but do not stand in for the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: General result assumes Taylor intersection array and 3<=mu<=k-2; icosahedron addressed separately. No classification of larger-weight functions. Historical priority may be incomplete; independent validation not performed.
title: Antipodal-pair rigidity of minimum two-rainbow domination on Taylor graphs
